import sys
from array import array

data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
n, m = data[0], data[1]

adj = [0] * n
pos = 2
for _ in range(m):
    x, y = data[pos] - 1, data[pos + 1] - 1
    pos += 2
    adj[x] |= 1 << y
    adj[y] |= 1 << x

size = 1 << n
dp = array('I', [0]) * size
dp[0] = 1

for mask in range(1, size):
    bit = mask & -mask
    rest = mask ^ bit
    v = bit.bit_length() - 1
    dp[mask] = dp[rest] + dp[rest & ~adj[v]]

print(dp[-1] - 1)
